ul.li: Supports downloading videos in multiple formats (mp4, webm, mp3, opus, flac, and wav)
Run multiple downloads at a time
Supports downloading metadata and video subtitles

description.p: - Added scheduled Cobalt URL renewal and stable-page fallback for expired CDN links
- Added conservative, balanced, and aggressive network retry strategies
- Added opt-in Firefox-session authentication and proxy bypass controls
- Finalized the Firefox-only download-manager roadmap
- Added modular direct, yt-dlp, and optional self-hosted Cobalt resolvers
- Added direct MP4, HLS, and DASH routing from Firefox media detection
- Added persistent scheduled downloads and per-download bandwidth limits
- Updated the Firefox add-on to protocol v3
- Added the first persistent download-manager architecture milestone on Windows
- Added SQLite browser recovery and high, normal, and low queue priorities
- Added pause, resume, priority, and active-download synchronization protocol commands
- Updated the Firefox add-on to protocol v2 and removed the previous double-handshake delay
- Added a Firefox in-player download interface backed by Native Messaging on Windows
- Added background downloads, quality presets, exact format selection, progress, cancellation, and open-folder actions
- Added on-demand stable yt-dlp update detection and installation
- Added Windows x64 and ARM64 Native Messaging host packages
- Fixed Flatpak x86_64 and aarch64 builds and refreshed bundled FFmpeg sources
- Improved time frame downloads to cut with ffmpeg instead of using yt-dlp's broken --download-sections option
- Fixed an issue where some playlists throw a requested format not available error
- Fixed an issue where the macOS configuration directory was incorrect
- Fixed an issue where None post processor argument would not be saved
- Fixed an issue where format strings were not translated correctly
- Fixed an issue where the application would not start on KDE
- Fixed an issue where the application would not start if the database file was invalid
- Fixed an issue where dependencies were missing from the macOS bundle
- Updated bundled deno
